{{Quote|A kiratta-sarn, while wonderful to look at, would be meaningless to you, I'm sure.|[[Unidentified Rakatan prisoner|Rakatan prisoner]] to [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''kiratta-sarn''' was an object, lifeform, or art style from the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. A [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Unidentified Rakatan prisoner|warrior]] trapped in a [[mind prison]] stated that it was specific to his culture, and therefore unusable in a riddle contest he had posed against [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] for one of them to escape the Rakatan prison. He did mention that it was beautiful to look at.
